title: THP task spec frontmatter
description: Machine-readable frontmatter for a .thp.md task spec. The markdown body below the frontmatter carries the human-readable intent and is not covered by this schema.

id.description: Stable identifier for this spec, used as the telemetry key. Defaults to a slug of the file name when omitted.

taskType.description: What kind of work this is (e.g. codegen, refactor, bugfix, test-gen, docs, explain). Open string: unrecognized values just get no affinity bonus from the router, they never fail validation.

contextGlobs.description: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace root, for files to attach as context. Defaults to none — THP never attaches file context you didn't ask for.

acceptance.description: A shell command run in the workspace root after a dispatch produces a diff. Exit 0 is a pass, anything else is a fail. Omit only when the task genuinely has no automatable acceptance criteria (e.g. prose/explanation tasks) — the resulting dispatch is recorded as 'skipped', never as 'passed'.

constraints.description: Free-text constraints injected verbatim into the prompt for every provider (e.g. "no new dependencies").

budget.description: Per-spec budget ceiling. Falls back to the workspace default in .thp/config.json, then to a hardcoded safety ceiling, when omitted.

pinnedProvider.description: Escape hatch: skip scoring and dispatch to this provider (or provider:model) directly. Format 'providerId' or 'providerId:modelId'. Does not bypass the budget ceiling — an over-budget pin requires explicit --force / confirmation.

expects.description: The shape of output this task produces. Drives the router's structured-output / tool-support hard filter.
